recipes.name: Healthier Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Soup
ingredients_raw: 2 (10 ounce) cans diced tomatoes and green chiles, undrained
1 (15 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer

steps.text: Combine diced tomatoes, chili beans, black beans, corn, beer, and tomato sauce in a slow cooker. Stir in onion, carrot, and taco seasoning until blended. Place chicken breasts on top of the mixture, pressing down on each one to slightly submerge. Cover and cook on Low for 5 hours.
Remove chicken breasts from the slow cooker and set on a cutting board to cool slightly, about 10 minutes. Shred meat and return to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on Low for 2 more hours.
Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with Cheddar cheese, cilantro, sour cream, and crushed tortilla chips.

raw_recipe.headline: Healthier Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Soup
raw_recipe.description: You can feel good eating this chicken taco soup made with a healthy dose of fresh veggies, reduced-fat cheese, low-sodium seasoning, and light sour cream.

review.reviewBody: I did not have Rotel (diced tomatoes with green chilies), what I did was use one can petite diced tomatoes and one 4 ounce can diced mild green chilies. I also used my own homemade taco seasoning and I threw in a couple cloves of fresh minced garlic. Very good.

Really good. I made into more of a stew. I just used a large can of rinsed black beans for the beans. For the sauce I used jar of Newmans own marinara sauce and can of chicken stock (No beer or diced tomatoes). I skipped the canned chillis. Used four chicken breasts. When I took the chicken out to shred it I added a 1/4 cup cornstarch and 1/4 cup water (mixed together in a small bowl first)to the sauce. Stirred in the chicken tasted the sauce and added more taco seasonings. I also added a tbsp of brown sugar.
Very good! I did not have beer, so I used chicken broth and it worked great. I also had precooked shredded chicken, so I just dumped it all together and simmered it for about 40 minutes. Delicious!

Yummy! I doubled the recipe, used low sodium everything, subbed veggie broth for beer, added sliced black olives, and 3 T minced garlic. Omitted carrots. Also for chicken, I shredded the white meat of 2 ready-made rotisserie chicken. Could easily go vegan w no chicken.

This has become a house favorite for my family! To make it more soupy, I add a can of low sodium chicken broth and my boyfriend loves when I put halved pearl onions in it. I also will chop up extra toppings for this like radishes, black olives and green onions. Whenever I go out of town I make sure to pre-prepare a dump bag of this for my boyfriend so he doesn't feed himself hamburgers the entire time I'm gone. Its a great recipe that is easy to build on and play with!
Amazing!!! I used hot rotel and threw in some jalapeños. Only had to cook for about 4 hours and then shredded the chicken. It’s spicy just the way I like it!
It's a keeper; super easy and everyone loved the flavor. Reviewed others' edits and went with replacing water with more broth and added a can of black beans. Yummy!

This is the easiest and most delicious recipe I have made -I make it every other week! I do not put in the second can of diced tomatoes but substitute it for about a half a cup to a cup of chicken broth so it doesn’t get too thick!! Everyone loves it -especially my husband who is on a low sodium diet and very very picky!
I’ve made this recipe for years and everyone loves it . I did not add the carrots and I always use frozen corn. Great recipe!

Wow, I wasn't sure about this, but it turned out delicious! Made just a couple changes - I hadn't planned on making it this evening, so I cooked it on the stovetop. I added 1 tbps of minced garlic with the onion and left out the carrot. Otherwise, followed the recipe exactly. Will definitely be making this again!

This soup has fabulous flavor and it's so easy. Set it and forget it, until it's time to shred the chicken. We don't care for cilantro, so I served the soup with sour cream, shredded Oaxaca cheese, and diced avocado. Very hearty, filling and healthy. Have some Doritos on the side if you like.
LEFT THE BEER OUT
I make my own taco seasonings. There are recipes on the website, and they're healthier because no preservatives.
My family loves. One of or favorite meals. The taste is so good. Not overpowering. I recommend trying this recipe.
Delicious.
Excellent, and easy to make. I added four breast instead of three, just the right amount of spices. So good, I'm making it again this weekend for lunches the coming week.
Great!!!!

I've made this at least twice a year for years. It tastes better the next day. I double up the recipe and we have leftovers for a week! I home make the taco seasoning as others suggested, and use Modelo Negra beer. You can switch up what beans you want to include, but always make sure to keep the juices in. Highly recommend!

Easy to make with ingredients I usually have in my pantry and freezer. I love recipes that don't require a special trip to the store! Not sure the beer added any flavor; chicken broth is probably just as good. I added Tabasco for more kick.
I used roasted chicken and put it in about half way of the cooking time.
